label: VS Code chat (template)
description: Copilot/chat panel map template for vision fallback when plugin socket is unavailable.
build_example: vdisplay map build --monitor DP-1 --crop-bounds x,y,w,h -o maps/vscode-chat.json
prompt_example: vdisplay ide prompt --ide vscode --map maps/vscode-chat.json --text "Review this diff"
